compendium.sqdecor.anim_strips.text:
LED strips whose segments light up one after another: strip, thin strip, double strip, corner strip and ring.

# Animations
- Right-click with redstone dust: next animation (static, chase, bounce, pulse, alternate, fill, twinkle, wave, rainbow).
- Right-click with glowstone dust: next speed.

# Color
- Dye, tuner and part wheel color the light and the cases like on every lamp; rainbow ignores the light color.
- The usual on/off, brightness and redstone work; when off the segments stay dark.
- Craft with a stonecutter from an LED panel.
compendium.sqdecor.anim_strips.title: Animated LED Strips
compendium.sqdecor.automatic.text:
Without a switch, every LED can run on its own. Set it in the tuner:

- Automatic at night: on when it gets dark.
- Automatic player nearby: on while a player is in range (2 to 32 blocks).

# Redstone
Newly placed LEDs and lamps switch with redstone right away (on/off). The tuner changes that:
- Off: redstone is ignored.
- Analog: brighter with a stronger signal.
- On/off: any signal turns it fully on.

Redstone is ignored while automatic is on.
compendium.sqdecor.automatic.title: Automatic and Redstone
compendium.sqdecor.basics.text:
Every LED and lamp is used the same way.

- Empty hand, short click: one step brighter.
- Empty hand, hold: a slider appears, move the mouse left or right and let go. Esc resets.
- Shift + empty hand: turns the lamp by 90 degrees.
- Dye: colors light, case and case 2 in turn. Hold the click for the part wheel.
- A block in the hand puts its texture on the case. With Shift you place the block normally.
- Redstone switches the lamp, the tuner sets everything else.
- Broken lamps keep their colors and cases.
compendium.sqdecor.basics.title: Using Lamps
compendium.sqdecor.beacon.text:
Rotating beacons like on police cars, fire trucks and ambulances. When on, two light beams circle around the dome.

- Blue and red come ready from the crafting table.
- Dye: any other color, like orange for a construction site.
- Works on floor, wall and ceiling.

Switch them like any LED: with a switch, the remote, redstone or a motion sensor.
compendium.sqdecor.beacon.title: Beacon Lights
compendium.sqdecor.bulbs.text:
The simplest lights. Place them on any side of a block.

The LED bulb is also an ingredient for most other lamps.
compendium.sqdecor.bulbs.title: LED Bulbs
compendium.sqdecor.cable_rack.text:
A small bar with 2, 3, 5 or 10 hooks. Each hook carries its own thin cable in its own color, for power lines between poles and houses.

# Placing
- Place it on a wall, floor or ceiling like a normal block.
- On a wall the bar lies flat. Sneak while placing to stand it upright.
- On floors and ceilings the bar runs across your view.

# Laying cables
1. Right-click a hook with thin cable.
2. Right-click a hook on a second holder, a cable clip or any surface (up to 32 blocks away). This uses 1 cable.
- Hook 1 to hook 1, hook 2 to hook 2 and so on keeps the lines parallel.

# Color
- Dye on a hook colors only the cable on that hook (default black).

# Taking down
- Breaking a holder releases its cables as items. The holder drops itself.
compendium.sqdecor.cable_rack.title: Cable Holder
compendium.sqdecor.cables.text:
Flat cable pieces with 1, 2 or 3 wires that lie straight across a block. Lay them in a row along floors, walls and ceilings.

# Laying
- Place on any side of a block: the cable lies on that side.
- It runs in the direction you are looking.
- Shift + right-click with an empty hand turns it by 90 degrees.

# With clips
- Every cable also comes with clips that hold it to the surface: cable + iron nugget.
- Pieces with and without clips fit together in one line.

# Color
- Dye on a cable colors it (default white).
- The cable keeps its color when you break it.
compendium.sqdecor.cables.title: Cables
compendium.sqdecor.cases.text:
Right-click a lamp with a block in hand: the case gets that block's texture, like wood, copper or concrete.

Works on all lamps with a case, like tubes, panels and the hanging lamp.
compendium.sqdecor.cases.title: Cases
compendium.sqdecor.ceiling.text:
Flat lights for ceilings and walls: round, square, ring, a round panel, a slim light bar and a globe lamp.

Made in the stonecutter: ceiling lights and the round panel from an LED panel, the light bar from an LED tube, the globe lamp from an LED bulb.

Color, case, brightness and switches work like on every lamp.
compendium.sqdecor.ceiling.title: Ceiling Lights
compendium.sqdecor.colors.text:
Right-click a lamp with a dye.

# Lamps with a case
- 1st click: the light.
- 2nd click: the case.
- 3rd click: case 2, if the lamp has one.
- Hold right-click with a dye: a wheel opens, pick the part you want.

The tuner sets any color you like, also as color temperature.
compendium.sqdecor.colors.title: Colors
compendium.sqdecor.computers.text:
With CC: Tweaked, place a computer next to an LED, lamp or marquee.

# LEDs
local led = peripheral.find("sqdecor_led")
led.setLevel(15)
led.setRGB(255, 120, 0)
led.rainbow(1)

# Marquee
local m = peripheral.find("sqdecor_marquee")
m.setText("Hello")

More: setAutoMode, gradient, chase, pulse, blink, stopAnimation, setSpeed, setOn.
compendium.sqdecor.computers.title: Computers
compendium.sqdecor.computers_decor.text:
Decorative computer gear: monitor, CRT, laptop, tower, server rack, keyboard, three framed pictures (graph, map, status), wall screen, wall terminal, radar screen and a blinking panel. The screens and LEDs are the light part, so dye them or set them with the tuner. Hold a dye on one to switch between light, case and case 2.

Made in the stonecutter from an LED panel. They are for show, to hook up real computers use the CC: Tweaked chapter.
compendium.sqdecor.computers_decor.title: Computers and Displays
compendium.sqdecor.controls.text:
Buttons, keypads, card readers, dial and slider panels, status boards and door lights.

- The lit parts are the bulb: color it with dye, the tuner or the part wheel; the LED tuner and remote work like on any LED.
- Purely decorative, they do not switch anything. Use the light switch for that.
compendium.sqdecor.controls.title: Buttons and Panels
compendium.sqdecor.create.text:
With Create, LEDs ride along on pistons, bearings and trains with the block they sit on. The schematicannon keeps their colors, and Shift + wrench picks them up.

On Create Aeronautics and Sable ships, LEDs weigh as little as a lantern.

Running tuner programs stop when the blocks get assembled.
compendium.sqdecor.create.title: Create and Airships
compendium.sqdecor.dimmer.text:
Links like a light switch.

- Right-click the upper half: brighter.
- Right-click the lower half: darker, the last step turns it off.

All linked LEDs fade to the new brightness.
compendium.sqdecor.dimmer.title: Dimmer
compendium.sqdecor.dusk.text:
Turns the light on when it gets dark outside and off at sunrise. Rain counts as darker.

Right-click the placed sensor to set how dark it must be (daylight 1 to 15).

Place it where it sees the sky.
compendium.sqdecor.dusk.title: Dusk Sensor
compendium.sqdecor.frames.text:
Blocks with a frame that joins up: put the same panel next to each other and the frame only runs around the outside, so many blocks look like one big plate. Works on walls, floors and ceilings.

- Four looks: plain frame, riveted, inset and tiles.
- Dye colors the block; differently colored panels still join.
- 8 iron ingots around an iron nugget, iron ingot, smooth stone or stone bricks: 8 panels.
compendium.sqdecor.frames.title: Frame Panels
compendium.sqdecor.glow.text:
Lamps that are on have a soft glow around the light.

Turn it off or make it weaker: Mods > SQ Decor > Config. This only changes your own view.
compendium.sqdecor.glow.title: Glow
compendium.sqdecor.hang_lamp.text:
Place it below a ceiling, the chain reaches up to it.

- Chain in hand: lamp lower.
- Shift + chain: lamp higher.
compendium.sqdecor.hang_lamp.title: Hanging Lamp
compendium.sqdecor.industrial.text:
Pendant light with a metal shade, cage light, high bay light, bulkhead light and a signal tower light. Best on the ceiling or wall.

Made in the stonecutter from a cage bulb. Color, case, brightness, switches and computers work like on every lamp.
compendium.sqdecor.industrial.title: Industrial Lights
compendium.sqdecor.industrial_blocks.tex:
Twenty-four metal, tile, brick and wood textures, each as a full block. For slabs, stairs and other shapes use Copycats+ or Framed Blocks.

All are white. Right-click with a dye colors them. The LED tuner sets any color (its housing color). Mined blocks keep their color.

- 4 iron ingots + 1 stone: 8 diamond plate blocks.
- Stonecutter: diamond plate gives every other texture.
compendium.sqdecor.industrial_controls.t:
Industrial switches that give redstone like a lever, and cabinets with a door.

- Industrial lever and rotary switch: right-click switches on and off.
- Emergency stop: a short redstone pulse like a button.
- Switch cabinet (standing) and fuse box (on the wall): right-click opens the door, inside are rows of breakers.
- Dye colors the housing (not the emergency stop).
compendium.sqdecor.industrial_props.text:
Floor and wall pieces (skirting, trim, grate, hatch, vent, ladder, hazard marking) and site gear: pylons, barrier post with chain, barrier bar, barrier fence, concrete barrier, railing, bollard, barrel, pallet, crate and a construction light.

They are white and color like a lamp: hold a dye to pick case or case 2, or hold a block for its texture. Shift + right-click with an empty hand turns them. The barrier bar, fence, railing, and chain post reach the block edge, so they line up in rows.

Made in the stonecutter from a diamond plate block (the construction light from an LED bulb).
compendium.sqdecor.it_gear.text:
Blade server rack, network switch, patch panel, UPS, tablet, terminal, monitor wall, digital clock, hologram projector, oscilloscope and a closed laptop.

- Screens and LEDs are the bulb part and glow like LEDs.
compendium.sqdecor.it_gear.title: Computers and Servers
compendium.sqdecor.lab.text: A desk lamp with a jointed arm (stonecutter, from an LED bulb) and a sealed tube light for the ceiling (stonecutter, from an LED tube).
compendium.sqdecor.lab.title: Lab Lights
compendium.sqdecor.light_switch.text:
Wireless, works across rooms. When on it also gives a redstone signal like a lever, strong into the block it hangs on.

# Linking
1. Place the switch on a wall, floor or ceiling.
2. Shift + right-click it with an empty hand: linking starts.
3. Shift + right-click with an empty hand on an LED: it and all LEDs touching it are linked.
4. Or click the block lamps hang on, e.g. the ceiling: all LEDs on that block are linked.
5. Shift + right-click the switch again: done.

Linked LEDs follow the switch right away. Clicking a linked LED again unlinks it. Clicking another switch or sensor in linking mode gives it the same channel, for a second switch in the same room.

Right-click turns all linked LEDs on or off. Mined switches keep their channel. All devices in this chapter link the same way.
compendium.sqdecor.light_switch.title: Light Switch
compendium.sqdecor.marquee.text:
A display with running text.

- Right-click: text, color, speed, on/off.
- Dye: color.
- Panels side by side facing the same way become one long line.
- Speed 0: the text stands still.

# Housings
Steel frame, hazard frame, slim, with bezel and exit route (green). Make them from a normal panel in the stonecutter; different housings in one row still share the text.
compendium.sqdecor.marquee.title: LED Marquee
compendium.sqdecor.monitor.text:
A flat screen for pictures, needs CC: Tweaked. Monitors side by side and on top of each other (same direction, a full rectangle, up to 8 x 8) become one big screen. Each block has 64 x 64 pixels.

On a wall it hangs flat, on the ceiling it lies flat with the picture facing down, on the floor it stands upright. Shift while placing: flat on the floor, or hanging upright from the ceiling. Placing it against a monitor takes over its direction, so the screen keeps growing.

Place a computer next to any monitor of the screen.

# Picture from the internet
local m = peripheral.find("sqdecor_monitor")
local h = http.get("https://.../bild.png", nil, true)
m.drawImage(h.readAll())
h.close()

The picture always fills the whole screen, square or not. m.drawImage(data, "fit") fits it in the middle without stretching.

# Drawing
m.clear("black")
m.setPixel(1, 1, 0xFF0000)
m.fill(5, 5, 10, 4, "lime")

Text anywhere: m.drawText(10, 20, "Hello", "white", 12) (x, y in pixels, size in pixels).

More: getSize, getResolution, setResolution(w, h) up to 512, getPixel, drawPixels(x, y, rows), drawImage(data, x, y, w, h). PNG, JPG, GIF and BMP work. 

# Touch
Right-click sends your computer the event sqdecor_touch (name, x, y in pixels from 1, player): local _, _, x, y = os.pullEvent("sqdecor_touch"). Shift + right-click shows size and pixels. 

# Resolution
The picture always fits the number of monitors (blocks x pixels per block, max 512). Shift + right-click switches the pixels per block (16, 32, 64, 128, 256) until it fits; the picture turns black and the computer gets the event sqdecor_resize (name, width, height) to redraw. Adding or removing monitors does the same.

# Fast drawing
Every single call waits one server tick. Draw many things in one call: m.batch({{"clear", 0}, {"fill", x, y, w, h, color}, {"text", x, y, "Hi", color, size}, {"ctext", x, y, w, h, "Hi", color, size}, {"pixel", x, y, color}}). m.measureText(text, size) gives the size of a text.

The normal monitor functions (setCursorPos, write, monitor_touch) do not exist here.
compendium.sqdecor.monitor.title: Image Monitor
compendium.sqdecor.more_lamps.text:
- Emergency light for the wall (stonecutter, LED panel).
- Cage wall light (stonecutter, cage bulb).
- Hanging tube light on two chains for the ceiling (stonecutter, LED tube).
- Traffic light, only the lower lens glows, dye it for red, yellow or green (stonecutter, LED bulb).
- Floor lamp and flask lamp (stonecutter, LED bulb).
- Neon ring for the wall (stonecutter, LED strip).

All with the white texture: dye, case blocks, tuner, switches and computers work like on every lamp.
compendium.sqdecor.more_lamps.title: More Lamps
compendium.sqdecor.motion.text:
Turns the light on when a player comes close and off again once nobody is there.

Right-click the placed sensor:
- Range: 2 to 16 blocks.
- Off after: 1 to 120 seconds.

It only turns off what it turned on itself.
compendium.sqdecor.motion.title: Motion Sensor
compendium.sqdecor.panels.text:
Flat ceiling panels, plain, beveled or louvered, and big square panels.

- 2 or 3 in a row: a longer panel.
- 2x2 or 3x3 square panels: one big panel.
- Stonecutter: the other panel styles.
compendium.sqdecor.panels.title: Panels
compendium.sqdecor.programs.text:
The remote plays light programs on a whole group: rainbow, chase, pulse and blink.

Open the remote and click the program button in the group's row until the program you want shows. Off ends it, Off for the group turns everything off.
compendium.sqdecor.programs.title: Light Programs
compendium.sqdecor.remote.text:
Controls up to 8 groups of lamps, from anywhere.

# Setting up
1. Right-click: the remote opens. Press New for a group and give it a name, like Kitchen or Garden.
2. Click the group's name to select it (▶).
3. Close the window, then Shift + right-click an LED: its network joins the selected group. Again: it leaves.

# Using
- The On/Off button in each row shows the state and switches the group.
- Next to it: how many LEDs belong to the group right now.
- Shift + right-click air: next group.
- Shift + right-click a switch: its lamps become a group too.
compendium.sqdecor.remote.title: Remote
compendium.sqdecor.scenes.text:
In the tuner, press Scenes: save the settings under a name, like Evening or Party. Up to 8 scenes.

Click a scene, then Shift + right-click an LED: the whole network changes.
compendium.sqdecor.scenes.title: Scenes
compendium.sqdecor.shelves.text:
Standing shelves with three boards, or tall ones with five boards (two blocks high). With lights under the boards or without.

- Lit shelf: LED strip + 4 wooden slabs.
- Shelf: 4 wooden slabs + a stick.
- Tall: a shelf + 2 wooden slabs.
- Wall shelf: LED strip + 1 wooden slab, with a light underneath.

Things you can put on a shelf: right-click a board with an item, three places per board, right-click with an empty hand takes it back. Dye colors the shelf instead, the boards are the case, the posts case 2. Hold Ctrl and right-click with a block to give them its texture, oak planks for a wood look. Without Ctrl the block is put on the board.
compendium.sqdecor.shelves.title: Lit Shelves
compendium.sqdecor.signals.text:
A status light (from an LED bulb), a segment display, a dot matrix display, a lit arrow, a lane closed signal, a bar display (all from an LED panel) and a signal post (from an LED bulb).

The lit parts take the light color, so dye them for red, green or amber. With a computer or switches they work as real indicators.
compendium.sqdecor.signals.title: Signals and Displays
compendium.sqdecor.signs.text:
Glowing signs for the wall: emergency exit, warning, arrow, no entry, stop, caution, parking, info, first aid, high voltage, check mark and cross. They come in the usual colors but can be dyed like any lamp. Shift + right-click with an empty hand turns them.

Made in the stonecutter from an LED panel.
compendium.sqdecor.signs.title: Signs
compendium.sqdecor.spotlight.text:
Shines in the direction it faces and lights up the spot it hits, up to 16 blocks away. Great for statues, signs and stages.

It shines away from the block it sits on: from the ceiling down to the floor, from a wall across the room.

Its brightness and color work like any other LED, so switches and the tuner control it too.
compendium.sqdecor.spotlight.title: Spotlight
compendium.sqdecor.spots.text:
Recessed spotlight, floodlight, track spotlights and triple spotlight. Like the spotlight they light up the spot they point at, up to 16 blocks away, and show a soft cone of light.

Made in the stonecutter from a spotlight.
compendium.sqdecor.spots.title: More Spotlights
compendium.sqdecor.strips.text:
Flat strips for floors, walls and ceilings, with corners, L-pieces and crosses to build lines.

The stonecutter turns a strip into the other shapes.
compendium.sqdecor.strips.title: Strips and Dots
compendium.sqdecor.style_fences.text:
Four fences: mechanical, mesh, clinic railing and energy.

- Fences connect to each other, to fence gates and to solid blocks like normal fences.
- They are white and take dye.
# Recipes
- Material, iron ingot, material in two rows = 6 fences.
- Material: copper ingot (mechanical), diamond plate block (mesh), white concrete (clinic), amethyst shard (energy).
compendium.sqdecor.style_fences.title: Fences
compendium.sqdecor.style_models.text:
Every style has four lamps, two shelves, two barrels or tanks and two pallets or crates.

- They color like any lamp: dye cycles light, case and case 2, a held block puts its texture on the case.
- Shift + right-click with an empty hand turns them.
- Shelves hold items like the other shelves (3 per board).
- The sci-fi canister, plasma tank, hover pallet, cargo crate and both sci-fi shelves glow.
- Lamps come from an LED bulb in the stonecutter, the rest from the fence of the style.
compendium.sqdecor.style_models.title: Lamps, Shelves, Barrels, Pallets
compendium.sqdecor.tape.text:
Striped tape that sags between two walls, like at a building site.

# Hanging
1. Right-click a wall: a hook is set.
2. Right-click a second wall or hook (up to 24 blocks away): the tape hangs between them. This uses 1 tape.
- A hook can carry several tapes.
- Shift + right-click air forgets the first hook.

# Color
- Dye on a hook colors the light stripes of the tape (default yellow).

# Taking down
- Breaking a hook releases its tapes as items.
compendium.sqdecor.tape.title: Caution Tape
compendium.sqdecor.temperature.text:
The tuner has a slider for white light in Kelvin:

- 1800 K: candle, very warm.
- 2700 K: cozy room light.
- 4000 K: neutral white.
- 6500 K: cool daylight.

Moving it sets the red, green and blue sliders for you.
compendium.sqdecor.temperature.title: Color Temperature
compendium.sqdecor.thin_cable.text:
A thin round cable for decoration, laid between small cable clips. It sags only a little, so it can run along walls, ceilings and floors.

# Laying
1. Right-click any surface: a clip is set (walls, floors, ceilings, also fences and slabs).
2. Right-click a second spot or clip (up to 32 blocks away): the cable runs between them. This uses 1 cable.
- Lay many short pieces from clip to clip to follow corners.
- A clip can hold several cables.
- Shift + right-click air forgets the first clip.

# Color
- Dye on a clip colors its cables (default black).

# Taking down
- Breaking a clip releases its cables as items.
compendium.sqdecor.thin_cable.title: Thin Cable
compendium.sqdecor.timer.text:
Turns the light on and off at set times of the Minecraft day.

Right-click the placed timer:
- On at: hour 0 to 23 (default 18, sunset).
- Off at: hour 0 to 23 (default 7, morning).

The remote can still switch in between, the timer switches again at the next set time.
compendium.sqdecor.timer.title: Timer Switch
compendium.sqdecor.title: SQ Decor Compendium
compendium.sqdecor.tubes.text:
Tube lights in one, two and three block lengths, single or double.

- 2 or 3 in a row on the crafting table: a longer lamp.
- 2 stacked: a double tube.
compendium.sqdecor.tubes.title: Tube Lights
compendium.sqdecor.tuner.text:
Sets brightness, color, redstone mode and automatic for many LEDs at once.

- Right-click air: settings.
- Right-click LED: apply to this LED.
- Shift + right-click LED: whole network (all touching LEDs).
- Hold right-click on an LED: copy its look into the tuner.

"Color for" chooses light, case or case 2.
compendium.sqdecor.tuner.title: LED Tuner
compendium.sqdecor.walkway.text:
A thin grating to walk on. Placed on top of a block it lies at the bottom, placed under a ceiling or on the top half of a side it sits flush at the top.

- Open edges get a railing on their own; next to another walkway or a wall it goes away.
- Shift + right-click with an empty hand near an edge turns the railing there on or off.
- Dye colors it.
- 2 iron ingots over 3 iron bars: 6 walkways.
compendium.sqdecor.walkway.title: Grating Walkway
compendium.sqdecor.wall_lamp.text: Just place it on a wall. Paint light and case like any other lamp.
compendium.sqdecor.wall_lamp.title: Wall Lamp
compendium.sqdecor.welcome.text:
SQ Decor brings LEDs, lamps, cables, switches and marquees.

Pick a chapter on the left or search for a word. Click a picture or an ingredient from SQ Decor to jump to its entry.

Scroll or use the arrow keys to turn pages.
compendium.sqdecor.welcome.title: Welcome
compendium.sqdecor.work_lights.text:
A work light on a stand (also twice as tall) and a small one with a handle. Place them on the floor, they shine to the side. Shift + right-click with an empty hand turns them.

Made in the stonecutter from a spotlight. The amber beacon fits a construction site too.
compendium.sqdecor.work_lights.title: Work Lights
compendium.sqdecor.workshop.text:
Furniture for workshops and offices: workbench with vise, tool wall, tool cabinet, desk, office chair and filing cabinet. They face you when placed.

- Dye colors the parts one after another, like the other decor.
- Made in the stonecutter from diamond plate.
compendium.sqdecor.workshop.title: Workshop and Office
gui.sqdecor.device.hint.on_hour: Minecraft clock: 6 is sunrise, 18 is sunset. Same time for on and off = always off.
gui.sqdecor.device.hint.range: The light turns on when a player comes within range and turns off once nobody was there for the set time.
gui.sqdecor.device.hint.threshold: Daylight goes from 15 (noon) to 0 (night). Below the set value the light turns on, above it turns off.
gui.sqdecor.marquee.speed_hint: Dots per second, 0 = text stands still
gui.sqdecor.marquee.title: LED Marquee
gui.sqdecor.remote.hint: Shift + right-click an LED: link it to the selected group (▶), again: unlink. Only loaded LEDs are counted.
gui.sqdecor.remote.name: Name
gui.sqdecor.remote.program_hint: Click: next light program for this group. Off ends the program.
gui.sqdecor.remote.switch_hint: Click: switch this group on or off
gui.sqdecor.remote.title: LED Remote
gui.sqdecor.scene.name: Name
gui.sqdecor.scene.save_hint: Saves what is set in the tuner right now. Same name = overwrite
gui.sqdecor.scene.title: Scenes
gui.sqdecor.tuner.auto_hint: At night: on when it gets dark. Player nearby: on while a player is within the range next to it. Redstone is ignored while this is on.
gui.sqdecor.tuner.auto_range_hint: How close a player has to be for "player nearby", in blocks.
gui.sqdecor.tuner.light_mode_hint: Normal: just the lit part. With glow: a soft glow around it. Spotlight: glow plus a light cone in the direction it shines.
gui.sqdecor.tuner.light_tint_hint: Whether glow and cone use the light color or stay white.
gui.sqdecor.tuner.part_hint: Case and Case 2 only apply to OBJ lamps like the LED tube and LED panel
gui.sqdecor.tuner.scenes_hint: Saved settings with a name, like Evening or Party
gui.sqdecor.tuner.temperature_hint: Warm white (1800 K, like a candle) to cool daylight (6500 K). Sets the light color.
gui.sqdecor.tuner.title: LED Tuner
item.sqdecor.caution_tape.hint1: Right-click a wall: sets a hook; click a second wall: the tape hangs between them
item.sqdecor.caution_tape.hint2: Shift + right-click air: forget the first hook. Dye on a hook colors the tape
item.sqdecor.dimmer_switch.hint1: Placed: Shift + right-click with empty hand, then click LEDs
item.sqdecor.dimmer_switch.hint2: Right-click upper half: brighter, lower half: darker
item.sqdecor.dimmer_switch.hint3: Wireless, also gives a redstone signal when on
item.sqdecor.dusk_sensor.hint1: Placed: Shift + right-click with empty hand, then click LEDs
item.sqdecor.dusk_sensor.hint2: Light on when it gets dark outside
item.sqdecor.led_remote.hint1: Right-click (also on an LED): all groups, switching and programs
item.sqdecor.led_remote.hint3: Shift + right-click LED: link/unlink with the selected group
item.sqdecor.led_remote.hint4: Shift + right-click switch: add its group
item.sqdecor.led_tuner.tooltip.hint3: Right-click LED: apply to this LED
item.sqdecor.led_tuner.tooltip.hint4: Shift + right-click LED: apply to all touching LEDs
item.sqdecor.led_tuner.tooltip.hint5: Hold right-click on LED: copy its look
item.sqdecor.light_switch.hint1: Placed: Shift + right-click with empty hand, then click LEDs
item.sqdecor.light_switch.hint2: Place it, then right-click: lights on/off
item.sqdecor.light_switch.hint3: Wireless, also gives a redstone signal when on
item.sqdecor.motion_sensor.hint1: Placed: Shift + right-click with empty hand, then click LEDs
item.sqdecor.motion_sensor.hint2: Light on while a player is close
item.sqdecor.thin_cable.hint1: Right-click any surface: sets a cable clip; click a second spot: the cable runs between them
item.sqdecor.thin_cable.hint2: Shift + right-click air: forget the first clip. Dye on a clip colors the cable
item.sqdecor.timer_switch.hint1: Placed: Shift + right-click with empty hand, then click LEDs
item.sqdecor.timer_switch.hint2: Light on and off at set times of day
message.sqdecor.cable_first: First clip set. Now click the second spot.
message.sqdecor.cable_no_wall: The clip needs something to hold on to
message.sqdecor.cable_rack_first: Hook %s chosen. Now click the second spot.
message.sqdecor.channel_none: No channel yet: Shift + right-click an LED or a switch first
message.sqdecor.link_start: Linking channel %s: Shift + right-click LEDs, lamps or the block they hang on with an empty hand. Shift + right-click this device again when done.
message.sqdecor.monitor_info: Screen %s x %s blocks, %s x %s pixels. Pictures come from a CC: Tweaked computer.
message.sqdecor.perf.chunks: Chunk rebuilds by LEDs per second: %s; chains in chunk meshes: %s, tapes in chunk meshes: %s, still drawn every frame: %s
message.sqdecor.perf.culling: Culling per frame: %s occlusion tests, %s postponed (time budget), %s outside the view; cable meshes rebuilt per second: %s
message.sqdecor.perf.leds: LEDs per frame: %s drawn, %s with nothing to draw, %s hidden; %s hot LEDs
message.sqdecor.remote_none: No groups yet: right-click to open the remote
message.sqdecor.scene_loaded: Scene "%s" loaded. Shift + right-click an LED: whole network
message.sqdecor.tape_first: First hook set. Now click the second spot.
message.sqdecor.tape_no_wall: The hook needs a solid wall
sqdecor.configuration.alarm_sounds.toolt: Alarm horns and beacon lights make sound while they are on
sqdecor.configuration.alarm_volume.toolt: Volume of alarm horns and beacon lights, 0 = silent, 1 = full
sqdecor.configuration.auto_max_range.too: Largest range of the automatic mode 'player nearby' in blocks (2 to 32)
sqdecor.configuration.cable_max_length.t: Longest thin cable span in blocks
sqdecor.configuration.chunk_meshes.toolt: Hanging lamp chains, caution tape and thin cables are built into the world like normal blocks instead of being drawn every frame, and running LED programs do not rebuild the chunk for every color. Turn off if something looks wrong
sqdecor.configuration.effect_view_distan: Lamp effects (glow, light cones, chains, shelf items) are drawn up to this many blocks away
sqdecor.configuration.halo.tooltip: Soft glow around LEDs that are on
sqdecor.configuration.light_cones.toolti: Light cones of spotlights and the turning beams of beacon lights
sqdecor.configuration.monitor.tooltip: Limits for the image monitor (CC: Tweaked)
sqdecor.configuration.monitor_max_resolu: Largest image monitor resolution per side in pixels (16 to 512)
sqdecor.configuration.monitor_sync_ticks: A changed picture goes to players at most every N ticks (2 = 10 pictures per second)
sqdecor.configuration.monitor_view_dista: Only players within this many blocks get the picture, 0 = everyone who sees the chunk
Glow, light cones, marquees, monitors and tape hidden behind solid blocks are not drawn (faster)
sqdecor.configuration.screen_view_distan: Marquees are drawn up to this many blocks away, image monitors a bit further the larger they are
sqdecor.configuration.spotlight_range.to: How far spotlights place light blocks, 0 = none
sqdecor.configuration.tape_max_length.to: Longest caution tape span in blocks
sqdecor.configuration.title: SQ Decor settings
